final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT pa.player_id, p.bats, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award AS pa JOIN player AS p ON pa.player_id COLLATE BINARY = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY pa.player_id, p.bats), step2 AS (SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM step1 GROUP BY bats), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT s2.bats, s2.player_count, CAST(s2.player_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(s3.total_count, 0) AS share FROM step2 AS s2 CROSS JOIN step3 AS s3 WHERE s3.total_count IS NOT NULL), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM step4) SELECT s4.bats, s4.player_count, s4.share, s4.share - s5.average_share FROM step4 AS s4 CROSS JOIN step5 AS s5 WHERE s5.average_share IS NOT NULL AND s4.share > s5.average_share
